supported_followup: One current data-access relation path joins dataset/tier, requester/class, purpose code, signed current non-granular reclassification, allowed fields and conditional retention maximum. Missing or conflicting scope abstains.
arithmetic_correction: Fraction(str(normalized supplied numeric value)) performs exact rational subtraction and compares before converting. Proof trace exact quantities use Fraction decimal/rational strings. This avoids both binary-float boundary error and finite Decimal-context cancellation.
additional_conservatism: Reject unknown nested operative request fields; preserve all original Round1 source and outcomes.
counterfactual_tests: Missing classification or alias edge abstains
Reordered JSON and historical distractors preserve actual current path
memo_guard: An optional memo is ignored only when its entire text explicitly states the supported draft summary is nonbinding; binding or ambiguous memos abstain.
